entities.summary: "Baby's Got a Temper" is a song by English electronic dance music group the Prodigy, released as a non-album single on 1 July 2002 by the record labels XL worldwide and Maverick in the United States. It was the band's first single in five years after 1997's "Smack My Bitch Up", and was also their first release after dancer Leeroy Thornhill left the band in 2000.
